author: Ari Koslow
title: Charlie Barnes designated for assignment
desc: The Dodgers designated LHP Charlie Barnes for assignment.
impact: Barnes loses his spot on the 40-man roster of the Dodgers. He will head to waivers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Yaramil Hiraldo activated from IL, optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Orioles activated RHP Yaramil Hiraldo from the 60-day injured list and optioned him to Triple-A Norfolk.
impact: Hiraldo had been sidelined since April with right shoulder inflammation. He will remain in Triple-A.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Helsley dealing with inflammation around UCL
desc: Ryan Helsley said he has inflammation around his UCL but the ligament itself is intact.
impact: Helsley went for a second opinion on his sore elbow. It is a positive report, though he remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chase Burns dealing with groin soreness
desc: Chase Burns is dealing with groin soreness.
impact: Burnes will look to get healthy during the All-Star break.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kazuma Okamoto blasts three-run homer in win over Padres
desc: Kazuma Okamoto went 1-for-3 in a 5-3 win over the Padres with a three-run home run and one walk.
impact: Okamoto has flashed his power stroke of late, going deep in three of his last four contests. The rookie has offered manager John Schneider one of the more explosive bats while fighting inconsistent stretches at the plate, batting .238 with 22 home runs, 62 RBI, and 49 runs scored through 91 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Louis Varland escapes traffic for save in win over Padres
desc: Louis Varland allowed one earned run on three hits while striking out one to earn the save in Friday's 5-3 win over the Padres.
impact: Varland continues a steady stretch out of the bullpen, holding opponents scoreless in eight of his last 10 contests. The right-hander has offered manager John Schneider an impactful closer option since taking over the role, carrying a 1.10 ERA and 0.98 WHIP with 19 saves, five holds, and a 12.3 K/9 ratio across 44 appearances.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Shane Bieber battles control in no-decision
desc: Shane Bieber allowed two earned runs on six hits and three walks while striking out four over 4 2/3 innings in Friday's win over the Padres.
impact: Bieber has offered mixed results on the mound, allowing four earned runs or more in two of his four trips to the mound. The right-hander continues to fight inconsistent command since returning from the injured list for manager John Schneider, posting a 7.64 ERA and 2.04 WHIP with a 0-1 record and 1.3 K/BB ratio through four starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Elly De La Cruz goes deep, triples in win over Cubs
desc: Elly De La Cruz went 2-for-5 in a win over the Cubs with a home run, a triple, one run scored, and one RBI.
impact: De La Cruz continues a solid stretch at the plate, picking up hits in nine of his last 12 contests. The shortstop has flashed his explosive potential as one of the more streaky bats in the Reds lineup for manager Terry Francona, carrying an .842 OPS with 15 home runs, 13 stolen bases, 44 RBI, and 49 runs scored across 74 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: JJ Bleday goes yard in shutout win
desc: JJ Bleday went 1-for-3 in a 4-0 win over the Cubs with a two-run home run and one walk.
impact: Bleday has heated back up at the plate, recording hits in seven of his last eight contests. The outfielder continues to flash his explosive bat as one of many streaky options in the Reds lineup to this point, posting an .838 OPS with 15 home runs, 41 RBI, 33 runs scored, and four stolen bases across 65 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Hunter Greene cruises through seven scoreless in win over Cubs
desc: Hunter Greene three hits and one walk while striking out 12 over seven scoreless innings in Friday's 4-0 win over the Cubs.
impact: Greene has offered mixed results on the mound since returning from injury, allowing more than four earned runs in one of his two trips to the mound. The right-hander will look to return to form as an elite starting option moving forward after Friday night's impressive start for manager Terry Francona, carrying a 6.97 ERA and 1.45 WHIP with a 1-1 record and seven or more strikeouts through both starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kevin McGonigle goes deep in win over Phillies
desc: Kevin McGonigle went 1-for-5 in a win over the Phillies with a two-run home run.
impact: McGonigle continues a consistent stretch of late, getting on base in each of his last 15 contests. The rookie continues to reward manager AJ Hinch with one of the more impactful options in a streaky Tigers lineup, carrying an .821 OPS with eight home runs, 34 RBI, 58 runs scored, and 11 stolen bases across 91 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Spencer Torkelson goes yard in win over Phillies
desc: Spencer Torkelson went 1-for-4 in a win over the Phillies with a two-run home run.
impact: Torkelson continues a productive stretch at the plate, driving in runs in seven of his last 12 contests. The first baseman remains one of the more frustrating options while flashing a productive bat at times as part of an inconsistent Tigers lineup, slashing .213 with 16 home runs, 43 RBI, and 38 runs scored across 93 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Colt Keith homers in win over Phillies
desc: Colt Keith went 1-for-5 in a win over the Phillies with a solo home run.
impact: Keith has heated up at the plate of late, recording hits in seven of his last nine contests. The 24-year-old remains one of many inconsistent bats in the Tigers lineup to this point, batting .249 with eight home runs, 22 RBI, 35 runs scored, and four stolen bases across 84 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jack Flaherty grinds through six in win over Phillies
desc: Jack Flaherty allowed two earned runs on two hits and three walks while striking out six over six innings in Friday's win over the Phillies.
impact: Flaherty continues a strong stretch on the mound of late, allowing two earned runs or less in five of his last six trips to the mound. The right-hander has returned to form as another impactful arm in the Tigers rotation after a dismal start to the season, posting a 4.48 ERA and 1.41 WHIP with a 3-8 record and 10.7 K/9 ratio through 18 starts.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Jake Woodford designated for assignment by Cubs
desc: The Chicago Cubs designated Jake Woodford for assignment on Saturday.
impact: Woodford signed with the Cubs on July 4 but will now go through waivers after Phil Maton (knee) was activated from the 15-day injured list. He made one appearance with the Cubs, allowing three runs across two innings out of the bullpen.
